warning_texts: analysis/answers/R01.json restates R01 as net revenue net of refunds and drops the 'over delivered orders' qualifier that raw_data/questions.md sets; CLM-NET-REVENUE itself is delivered-only and says so in its caveats, so only the restated question is affected.

The partner channel has a much larger pending share than direct (about 20 per cent against 14 per cent in each month), so part of the completion gap is orders not yet resolved; on resolved orders only (delivered against delivered plus cancelled) the gap narrows to about 0.08 but keeps its sign in ev

Both test claims record alpha 0.05 with correction bonferroni but never state the adjusted per-test alpha of 0.025; both p values are near zero, so the conclusion does not change, but the correction is named rather than shown as applied.

The R03 and R04 facts carry each interval without its level, method or n beside it; the spec's estimate_rendering asks for the n next to every estimate, which the claims hold but the answer files do not repeat.

Confounding by country was checked and ruled out: each channel's country mix is within half a percentage point of a third per country, and the direct-minus-partner difference in completion and in AOV is positive in CZ, DE and PL and in each of January, February and March.

The recompute_estimate, recompute_test and min_group_size rules read clean_data/orders_clean.csv rather than raw; only claims_recomputed is rooted in raw_latest. This audit's own recalculation from quarantine/orders.csv agrees with both.
summary: All eight claims recompute independently from quarantine/orders.csv with no gap (orders 44531, net revenue 3023296.61, Wilson and Student intervals, z 26.718455, Welch t 42.699880, effects 0.119652 and 0.486900), and every value, bound, n, level, method, hypothesis, alpha and correction in the register matches metrics and the frozen plan. The sign of both channel differences holds in every country and every month, and cancelled and pending orders stay in the completion denominators.
